goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Komplexe Zahlen in algebraischer Form additiv nutzen
goalCourseMatrix.wholeContractRationale: Complex Julia/Mandelbrot iteration needs a+bi and component addition; subtraction belongs to the authored elementary addition/subtraction foundation. This is an explicit didactic operationalization of a positive optional theme, not a quoted universal standard.

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Komplexe Zahlen in Polarform und Gaußscher Zahlenebene darstellen
goalCourseMatrix.wholeContractRationale: Gauss/complex-plane interpretation is a positive part of the iteration theme; the full polar/exponential change of form and phi=omega*t are not fully established by it. Missing: an official/course-specific positive whole polar-and-time-phase demand. Retention is conservative, not a whole-source PASS.

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Gleichungen in der Menge der komplexen Zahlen lösen
goalCourseMatrix.wholeContractRationale: General solving of complex equations, including nonreal quadratic solutions, is not demanded by the named introduction/iteration. Standard real quadratic/discriminant work is not this contract.

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Komplexe Zahlen algebraisch dividieren
goalCourseMatrix.wholeContractRationale: Conjugate-based algebraic complex division is not part of the closed standard/optional C lists. Mandelbrot iteration uses z²+c, no complex divisor; no task score/coverage can be fabricated.

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Einheitswurzeln komplexer Zahlen am Einheitskreis deuten (LK)
goalCourseMatrix.wholeContractRationale: All n-th complex unity roots and their geometry are an extra whole competency; real roots or polar representation alone do not establish it.

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Komplexe Zahlen algebraisch multiplizieren
goalCourseMatrix.wholeContractRationale: The quadratic complex iteration uses complex multiplication and i²=−1. The existing general multiplication foundation is a reasonable authored realization; no newly invented requirement edge is added.

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Mandelbrot-Folgen komplexer Zahlen softwaregestützt untersuchen (LK)

goalCourseMatrix.wholeGoalTitle: Grundrechenarten in der Gaußschen Zahlenebene deuten
